# Canada Global Export Council
# https://cgec.ca
# llms.txt per the llmstxt.org standard

> CGEC is Canada's not-for-profit export council connecting Canadian businesses to buyers, partners and institutions in the United Kingdom, the European Economic Area and Asia. CGEC is the exclusive Canadian partner of the Europe India Centre for Business and Industry (EICBI), a European Parliament-accredited geopolitical forum registered on the EU Transparency Register at number 423661050520-44.

## About

- [About CGEC](https://cgec.ca/about.html): Mission, governance, values and how CGEC is structured.
- [EICBI Partnership](https://cgec.ca/eicbi.html): CGEC's exclusive partnership with the Europe India Centre for Business and Industry, founded 2011, EU Transparency Register No. 423661050520-44, accredited by the European Parliament.

## Markets

- [Markets Overview](https://cgec.ca/markets.html): CGEC's three export corridors: United Kingdom, European Economic Area and Asia.
- [United Kingdom](https://cgec.ca/markets.html#uk): Post-Brexit market access, Canada-UK Trade Continuity Agreement, NHS procurement, FCA fintech sandbox.
- [European Economic Area](https://cgec.ca/markets.html#eea): CETA, EU Green Deal, Critical Raw Materials Act, Horizon Europe, EU AI Act.
- [Asia](https://cgec.ca/markets.html#asia): India's 500 GW renewable commitment, UPI digital infrastructure, government procurement introductions via EICBI.

## Programmes

- [Programmes Overview](https://cgec.ca/programmes.html): Four structured programmes from market entry to signed commercial relationships.
- [Market Entry Assessment](https://cgec.ca/programmes.html#entry): Written report on corridor fit, regulatory requirements and first-contact shortlist.
- [Parliamentary Trade Missions](https://cgec.ca/programmes.html#missions): Curated delegations to Brussels, London and India via EICBI.
- [Partner and Buyer Matching](https://cgec.ca/programmes.html#matching): Verified introductions to buyers, distributors, institutions and procurement offices.
- [Regulatory Advisory](https://cgec.ca/programmes.html#advisory): Practical regulatory orientation and introductions to specialist advisors.

## Membership

- [Membership Tiers](https://cgec.ca/membership.html): Associate, Full Member and Corporate Partner tiers with detailed comparison.
- [Apply for Membership](https://cgec.ca/apply.html): Membership application form.

## News

- [News and Insights](https://cgec.ca/news.html): Trade policy briefings and market intelligence across all three corridors.
